(UX-5-1) At 390px width on `/projects/<2001>/retrospective?dossier=5001`, every control in the form that takes keyboard focus (reached by Tab from the first box through to Save and the decisions and follow-up controls) ends fully above the fixed Save bar: its bounding box bottom is at or above the bar's top. risk.rationale: Medium, unchanged from F-119. The screen has several behaviours (versioned save, action creation, checklist link) and a cross-layer contract (revisions, evidence ids, the `summary` convention). It writes internal meeting records only; no money, payroll, external messaging, auth or migrations, and saves append versions. Surfaces are ui (phone layout and focus behaviour, product-visible form change), api (live 1.24.0 operations) and contract-change (three boxes packed into one `summary`). Product acceptance is required for the changed form layout and the hidden draft, as in F-119.

findings.summary: AC 24 (UX-5-1) says "every control in the form that takes keyboard focus (reached by Tab from the first box through to Save and the decisions and follow-up controls)". The phone test (`frontend/e2e/retrospective.spec.ts` ~L416-441) checks only "What didn't" (focus), "Lessons for next projects", Tunde Bello, Ada Obi and "Add a decision". It never checks "What went well", the Reference field, the Notes file select, the decision fields, the follow-up controls, or Save. The criterion's own check is therefore not met as written, and a regression on those controls would pass. Expected: a Tab walk from the first box to the last control (or a loop over all focusable controls in `form` that excludes the bar's own controls), with the same bottom-above-bar and `elementFromPoint` assertions for each. Actual: five sampled controls. Path: `frontend/e2e/retrospective.spec.ts:416-441`.

refs: Read the new walk: it loops Tab until focus leaves the form (fail) or reaches the bar (pass, 80-step cap), polls each stop until its bottom is at or above the bar top +1 (Save in the bar is exempt), and asserts `elementFromPoint` hit for every in-form stop. Two forms are walked: empty (7 stops, asserted > 6) and 2002 with a carried decision (asserted more stops than the first). Decision text, supporting-file select and Remove are inside the form before Save on phone, so they are walked. Builder's 27/27 e2e run on this head is the evidence; not re-run by me.

findings.summary: `clearOfBar` (`RetroForm.tsx`, the `requestAnimationFrame` in the focus handler) is not cancelled when the form unmounts or the focus moves again. The callback reads `bar.current` and calls `window.scrollBy` after the component may have gone, which is harmless today but can scroll a page the user has left. Expected: keep the frame id and `cancelAnimationFrame` it in an effect cleanup, or accept as a known trade-off. Path: `frontend/src/features/retrospective/RetroForm.tsx` (`clearOfBar`).

refs: `RetroForm.tsx`: `frame` ref; `cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current)` before each new `requestAnimationFrame` in `clearOfBar`; `useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current), [])` on unmount. Phone-only guard and the `el.contains(target)` early return are unchanged.

findings.summary: AC 24's parenthetical names "the decisions and follow-up controls" as reached by Tab from the first box to Save. The walk covers the decisions. The follow-up controls are `ActionForm` in `RetrospectiveView.tsx` (~L177), rendered only when the form is not shown (`!(form && editing)`), so they never coexist with `.retro__savebar` and cannot be drawn under it. The criterion text and the test scope disagree. Expected: product or the spec owner confirms that follow-up controls are out of the bar check (or the criterion is reworded), and the spec records it. Actual: no test on `ActionForm` controls; no occlusion path exists today. Path: `frontend/e2e/retrospective.spec.ts` (walk, ~L413-462), `frontend/src/features/retrospective/RetrospectiveView.tsx:168-185`, `delivery/features/F-119B/spec.md` AC 24.

The walk starts by focusing "What went well" with `preventScroll` at scroll 0 and then presses Tab, so the starting box itself is never hit-tested. At scroll 0 it is almost certainly clear of the bar, but AC 24 says "from the first box". Expected: run the same poll and `elementFromPoint` assertion on the starting box before the first Tab. Actual: the first assertion is on the second stop. Path: `frontend/e2e/retrospective.spec.ts` (`walk` start, `field(page, 'What went well').evaluate(...focus...)`).
